Definition: an Asherite (collectively) or descendant of Asher
BiblicalUsage: The Asherites are the tribe of Asher, named once, in the conquest that was never finished. The Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land, for they did not drive them out.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for a tribe that dwelt among the Canaanites carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the failure in it, that Asher kept the land but not the victory, and lived among the people God told them to drive out.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
